verdict.rationale: Headless automation is a fair question for an IP-operations service with online filing and searchable databases, so the axis applies. The pack only describes web-based filing procedures (trademark, patent, design, e-Soleau) and database search, with no documented API, CLI, or CI integration. The probe shows data.inpi.fr rejects keyless requests and mentions an account-issued token, but it does not document any headless or CI workflow, so it earns no credit.
